fusions.name: Skitter Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a scale that deals 4 damage. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3s after you use it.

fusions.name: Hind-Leg Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of spray 3.5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds and your dodge chance by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Springing Stroke
fusions.desc: After you travel a stretch of ground, your critical chance rises 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
